# Dependency Upgrade Fix: @google-cloud/translate 1.0.0 → 2.1.3

## Context

You are working on the **GoogleCloudPlatform/nodejs-docs-samples** Node.js (npm/yarn) project. The dependency **`@google-cloud/translate`** has been upgraded from version **1.0.0** to **2.1.3** in the project's manifest/lock files. This upgrade introduces breaking changes that cause test failures.

The dependency upgrade (manifest/lock file changes) has already been applied. Your job is to **fix the source code** so that the upgraded project's test suite passes against the new version of the dependency.

## Working Directory

The project source code is located at `/app`. The relevant subdirectory is `/app/functions/ocr/app`.


## Constraints

- **Do not modify any test files.** The test suite is the evaluation oracle and will be re-applied verbatim before grading.
- Restrict your changes to the project's source code so that the existing tests pass against the upgraded dependency.
